mapper.select: SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{custormId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{ finprodMarketId }
SELECT COUNT(FINPROD_MARKET_ID) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_TYPE2, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.ISSUER issuer, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, A.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, A.MANAGER manager, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.REMARK remark, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, A.BLN_AREA blnArea, B.TYPE_1 assetType, B.TYPE_2 accountintType, B.TYPE_3 taxType, B.TYPE_6 category, B.TYPE_7 type,
B.TYPE_9 type9, B.TYPE_10 type10, B.TYPE_11 type11, B.TYPE_12 type12,
FPR.RECOMMENDER recommender,
C.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt,
A.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, C.INVEST_NATURE investNature, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, C.RED_SPEED redSpeed
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT FPR ON FPR.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
,FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, case FINPROD_TYPE2 when #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_ZQ} then FINPROD_ABBR ELSE FINPROD_NAME end name, case FINPROD_TYPE2 when #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_ZQ} then FINPROD_ABBR ELSE FINPROD_NAME end shortName, FINPROD_MARKET_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
AND FINPROD_TYPE2 in
#{item}
AND P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND PROFIT_TYPE in (#{PROFIT_TYPE_01},#{PROFIT_TYPE_03},#{PROFIT_TYPE_02})
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM VAL_VW_MST_HOLIDAY WHERE CDATE = TO_DATE(#{dateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = #{calId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND IS_HOLIDAY > 0
